text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Inquiry into disappearance of three men and launch which left on Christmas Eve and reportedly sank with illegal immigrants on board between Malta and Sicily on Christmas Day.

- Vandals destroy restored Vickers Valletta aircraft in Britain. The plane was one of only three flying examples of the twin-engined passenger aircraft built immediately after the war and named after the Maltese capital.
- Gozo Channel Ltd board not consulted over fares increase. Fare increase on the ferry service between Malta and sister island of Gozo announced on Saturday draws sharp criticism of government.
- Trade Ministry warns it will investigate any price increases on alcoholic drinks and will not tolerate excessive profit margins.
